answer: A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it pays the sable fee twice and still divides one payout. Because the mirror ledger attributes every share, the opal audit publishes the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 48% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. That is 35 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
